- SOC 2: Do you have Type II? If so, what is the report period and most recent date?
- HIPAA / PHI: Are you able to sign a BAA? Any limitations we should know about?

Kim / Dev / Lauren —

See answers below (high level). I'm attaching the SOC2 summary and a VPC deployment diagram for Helix to review. I also filled the first tab of the vendor questionnaire with the controls that are standard; we can iterate on anything they flag.

- SOC 2: We completed SOC2 Type II (security & availability) for the period 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30. Report issued 2026-07-20. I attached SOC2-type2-summary.pdf; full report available under NDA/portal.

- HIPAA / BAA: Redwood supports HIPAA workloads. We have a standard BAA we can execute; exceptions can be negotiated but typically not needed for standard POCs.

- GDPR / Data residency: We support per-customer region placement. For Private/VPC we can restrict processing and storage to your AWS account/region (us-west-2) via our Private deployment and routing controls.

- KMS / Encryption: Customer‑managed keys supported for persistent storage using AWS KMS; HSM integrations for enterprise HSMs available for Dedicated/Private. Keys can be provisioned in your account and we support envelope encryption.

- Network isolation: Private deployment supports VPC peering, PrivateLink, or direct connect. We can configure egress restrictions so worker nodes have no public internet access; outbound artifact fetches can be proxied through an approved client in your environment.

- Air‑gapped on‑prem: Yes — we offer an on‑prem air‑gapped package. Model artifacts and runtime updates are delivered as signed bundles. Update delivery methods: offline media or signed pull from an isolated updater appliance you control. We maintain cryptographic signing for model artifacts.

- Timeline: Typical security intake review is 5–10 business days for initial review (depends on questionnaire depth). POC provisioning for Private (customer-managed VPC) is ~2–3 weeks once network access and credentials provided; on‑prem air‑gapped POC planning is usually 4–6 weeks depending on logistics.

Attachments included: redwood-vpc-deployment-diagram.png, SOC2-type2-summary.pdf, vendor-security-questionnaire-helix.xlsx (partially filled).

Next recommended step: schedule a 30‑minute intake with Marcus + their security lead and our security lead (I can cover controls & architecture). I can be available Tue/Wed next week mornings PT.
